title: Provider-neutral insurance appointment domain + D1 executor
domainRules: appointment targets must be absolute timestamps and normalize to UTC ISO
clear maps appointmentAt to undefined in domain state and SQL NULL in persistence
equivalent targets are no-op and do not advance updatedAt
changed state requires occurredAt strictly later than relationship.updatedAt
schedule and reschedule append the existing appointment-set event
clear emits no fabricated appointment-set event
appointment mutation preserves stage, nextFollowUpAt, owner, contact fields, and relationship identity
persistenceRules: use optimistic compare-and-set on relationship_id plus previous updated_at
schedule/reschedule insert immutable appointment-set evidence first under the pre-mutation concurrency token, then compare-and-set the relationship inside the same atomic D1 batch
clear performs only the narrow relationship update
zero relationship rows changed is an optimistic-concurrency conflict
